changes: Fixed: Plinko balls still weren't landing dead-centre in their slot after the previous attempt. Switched approach entirely — instead of calculating the slot's centre from outside it (getBoundingClientRect math across two separate elements, which was mathematically sound but still wasn't producing a centred result in practice), the ball now reparents directly into its landed slot and uses simple 50%/50% centring relative to the slot's own box. The browser's layout engine does the centring natively rather than a cross-element coordinate calculation.
Fixed: balls appearing too close together — reduced ball size from 20px to 16px, giving real breathing room between balls landing in neighbouring slots on a multi-ball drop.
